Dadi ne poocha: "Mujhe khaansi-zukaam hai, operation hoga ya nahi?" 🤧
Dr Saathi ne kaha: Dadi, pehle humein bataiye, phir hum milkar sahi faisla karenge! 💚

Sach kya hai?
✅ Operation se pehle khaansi, zukaam ya bukhaar ho toh pehle hi apne doctor ko bataiye
✅ Saans ka infection anaesthesia ke dauraan dikkat ka risk badha sakta hai
✅ Halke zukaam mein har baar operation nahi rukta, doctor jaanch karke faisla karte hain
✅ Zaroorat ho toh operation ki taareekh aage ki jaati hai, sirf aapki suraksha ke liye
Koi bhi sawaal ho, apne doctor se poochhiye.
